name: comp-114
title: Fork Count Split Button
blurb: Fork button with a count badge and dropdown options button.
description: A primary fork button with an inline count badge (18) and a dropdown chevron button. Divided with a subtle line.
use_when: Showing fork count in a GitHub-like interface with additional options.
avoid_when: When count is dynamic or when dropdown functionality is not implemented.
a11y: Uses aria-label on the dropdown button and aria-hidden on icons. Count is visible in the badge.
